slides.note: The assurance layer above any model, gateway, prover, or format.

slides.title: The problem is structural, not a model away
bullets: Base models can't keep context TRUE, CURRENT, or PROVABLE — they have no live access to the authoritative source.
Context cost collapsed (free 1M windows), so 'stuff more in' closes only the TRANSIENT gaps.
The durable gap — verification, freshness, source-authority, receipts — does NOT close when the next model ships.

slides.title: The wedge: assurance above the stack
slides.subtitle: {wedge}
bullets: VERIFICATION — measured lift + source-bound outputs, not vibes.
FRESHNESS / CDC — a stale fact is HELD OUT, never served, until re-synced.
EARNED SOURCE-AUTHORITY — 'independent authorities AGREE', not 'a source says'.
PORTABLE RECEIPTS — every governed action carries a verifiable, cross-vendor record.

slides.title: The self-improving, auto-optimizing capability unit
slides.subtitle: {proposition}
bullets: It MEASURES itself across the improvement dimensions and auto-applies the best GOVERNED method for each.
Live receipt on a regulated-fact capability:
· input tokens  {receipt_tokens_before} → {receipt_tokens_after}   (compression, lossless)
· cost/call     ${receipt_cost_before} → ${receipt_cost_after}    (distilled to a deterministic rule)
· determinism   {receipt_det_before} → {receipt_det_after}     (non-deterministic → deterministic)
· stale-served risk  {receipt_fresh_before} → {receipt_fresh_after}   (bound to the authoritative source)
· model cost/Mtok    ${receipt_model_before} → ${receipt_model_after}  (cheapest still-capable)
{governance}

slides.title: Distilling the primitives of context
bullets: COMPRESSION — tokens↓: collapse whitespace, dedupe lines, prune [optional]; lossless (must-keep survives).
FRAGILITY → FRESHNESS — bind a changing fact to its source; stale held out, re-synced on CDC.
ENRICHMENT — add source handles + lineage + receipts so an answer is provable, not just plausible.
EFFICIENCY — descend to a cheaper/smaller/faster model when determinism is impossible (honest, not faked).

slides.title: A method for every dimension, a module for every method
bullets: {n_dimensions} improvement dimensions × {n_methods} methods × {n_modules} researched candidate modules.
Each module is license-governed (vendorable vs adopt-behind-a-port); discovery ≠ trust.
The runtime auto-selects the best governed method per dimension — and proves the result.

slides.title: Governed breadth, not a single trick
bullets: Profession-scale seeder: {n_professions} regulated professions → durable governed capabilities (O*NET/WORKBank).
Standards interop at the edges: {n_built_standards} built (OKF · FollowTheMoney · SKILL.md · native) — adopt the open format, govern above it.
{n_proofs} deterministic proofs green; preflight GO; the whole stack runs locally (emulated, no cloud needed).

slides.title: Why this is defensible
bullets: The format wars ended (SKILL.md, OKF) → format isn't a moat; ASSURANCE is.
Data-gravity platforms race the context layer but DON'T verify truth — the white space is confirmed by their own moves.
Funded validators (Pramaana $27M, Probably $9M) prove the category; we're the OPEN, provider-neutral layer above any one of them.

slides.title: Where we are — honestly
bullets: {n_proofs} deterministic proofs green; the assurance/descent engine runs end-to-end; local emulation of every go-live seam.
Honest gap: candidate breadth is discovery-stage; live cloud go-live needs owner-provisioned hosting + keys.
Each local emulator de-risks exactly one live seam — the path is built, not hand-waved.
